decisions.statement: A point said in seconds reaches Spotify in milliseconds.
A call naming no point is refused rather than moving anything.
A device named on the command line is moved rather than the active device.
A call saying `--json` is answered one line of JSON, and one saying nothing words.
The move is handed in, so no test of it reaches Spotify.

definition: the command moving the playing track to a point counted from its opening
